record.bible_text: Now Jephthah<WH03316> the Gileadite<WH01569> was a mighty man<WH01368> of valour<WH02428>, and he <FI>was<Fi> the son<WH01121> of an harlot<WH0802><WH02181><WTH8802>: and Gilead<WH01568> begat<WH03205><WTH8686> Jephthah<WH03316>. <RF>Jephthah: Gr. Jephthae<Rf> <RF>an harlot: Heb. a woman an harlot<Rf>

And Gilead's<WH01568> wife<WH0802> bare<WH03205><WTH8799> him sons<WH01121>; and his wife's<WH0802> sons<WH01121> grew up<WH01431><WTH8799>, and they thrust out<WH01644><WTH8762> Jephthah<WH03316>, and said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto him, Thou shalt not inherit<WH05157><WTH8799> in our father's<WH01> house<WH01004>; for thou <FI>art<Fi> the son<WH01121> of a strange<WH0312> woman<WH0802>.

Then Jephthah<WH03316> fled<WH01272><WTH8799> from<WH06440> his brethren<WH0251>, and dwelt<WH03427><WTH8799> in the land<WH0776> of Tob<WH02897>: and there were gathered<WH03950><WTH8691> vain<WH07386> men<WH0582> to Jephthah<WH03316>, and went out<WH03318><WTH8799> with him. <RF>from: Heb. from the face <FI>of<Fi> <Rf><CM>
And it came to pass in process of time<WH03117>, that the children<WH01121> of Ammon<WH05983> made war<WH03898><WTH8735> against Israel<WH03478>. <RF>in process...: Heb. after days<Rf>

And it was so, that when the children<WH01121> of Ammon<WH05983> made war<WH03898><WTH8738> against Israel<WH03478>, the elders<WH02205> of Gilead<WH01568> went<WH03212><WTH8799> to fetch<WH03947><WTH8800> Jephthah<WH03316> out of the land<WH0776> of Tob<WH02897>:
And they said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto Jephthah<WH03316>, Come<WH03212><WTH8798>, and be our captain<WH07101>, that we may fight<WH03898><WTH8735> with the children<WH01121> of Ammon<WH05983>.

And Jephthah<WH03316> said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto the elders<WH02205> of Gilead<WH01568>, Did not ye hate<WH08130><WTH8804> me, and expel<WH01644><WTH8762> me out of my father's<WH01> house<WH01004>? and why are ye come<WH0935><WTH8804> unto me now when ye are in distress<WH06887><WTH8804>?

And the elders<WH02205> of Gilead<WH01568> said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto Jephthah<WH03316>, Therefore we turn again<WH07725><WTH8804> to thee now, that thou mayest go<WH01980><WTH8804> with us, and fight<WH03898><WTH8738> against the children<WH01121> of Ammon<WH05983>, and be our head<WH07218> over all the inhabitants<WH03427><WTH8802> of Gilead<WH01568>.

And Jephthah<WH03316> said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto the elders<WH02205> of Gilead<WH01568>, If ye bring me home again<WH07725><WTH8688> to fight<WH03898><WTH8736> against the children<WH01121> of Ammon<WH05983>, and the LORD<WH03068> deliver<WH05414><WTH8804> them before<WH06440> me, shall I be your head<WH07218>?

And the elders<WH02205> of Gilead<WH01568> said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto Jephthah<WH03316>, The LORD<WH03068> be witness<WH08085><WTH8802> between us, if we do<WH06213><WTH8799> not so according to thy words<WH01697>. <RF>witness...: Heb. the hearer between us<Rf>

Then Jephthah<WH03316> went<WH03212><WTH8799> with the elders<WH02205> of Gilead<WH01568>, and the people<WH05971> made<WH07760><WTH8799> him head<WH07218> and captain<WH07101> over them: and Jephthah<WH03316> uttered<WH01696><WTH8762> all his words<WH01697> before<WH06440> the LORD<WH03068> in Mizpeh<WH04709>.<CM>

And Jephthah<WH03316> sent<WH07971><WTH8799> messengers<WH04397> unto the king<WH04428> of the children<WH01121> of Ammon<WH05983>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>, What hast thou to do with me, that thou art come<WH0935><WTH8804> against me to fight<WH03898><WTH8736> in my land<WH0776>?

And the king<WH04428> of the children<WH01121> of Ammon<WH05983> answered<WH0559><WTH8799> unto the messengers<WH04397> of Jephthah<WH03316>, Because Israel<WH03478> took away<WH03947><WTH8804> my land<WH0776>, when they came up<WH05927><WTH8800> out of Egypt<WH04714>, from Arnon<WH0769> even unto Jabbok<WH02999>, and unto Jordan<WH03383>: now therefore restore those <FI>lands<Fi> again<WH07725><WTH8685> peaceably<WH07965>.
And Jephthah<WH03316> sent<WH07971><WTH8799> messengers<WH04397> again<WH03254><WTH8686> unto the king<WH04428> of the children<WH01121> of Ammon<WH05983>:

And said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto him, Thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> Jephthah<WH03316>, Israel<WH03478> took not away<WH03947><WTH8804> the land<WH0776> of Moab<WH04124>, nor the land<WH0776> of the children<WH01121> of Ammon<WH05983>:

But when Israel<WH03478> came up<WH05927><WTH8800> from Egypt<WH04714>, and walked<WH03212><WTH8799> through the wilderness<WH04057> unto the Red<WH05488> sea<WH03220>, and came<WH0935><WTH8799> to Kadesh<WH06946>;

Then Israel<WH03478> sent<WH07971><WTH8799> messengers<WH04397> unto the king<WH04428> of Edom<WH0123>, saying<WH0559><WTH8800>, Let me, I pray thee, pass through<WH05674><WTH8799> thy land<WH0776>: but the king<WH04428> of Edom<WH0123> would not hearken<WH08085><WTH8804> <FI>thereto<Fi> . And in like manner they sent<WH07971><WTH8804> unto the king<WH04428> of Moab<WH04124>: but he would<WH014><WTH8804> not <FI>consent<Fi> : and Israel<WH03478> abode<WH03427><WTH8799> in Kadesh<WH06946>.

Then they went along<WH03212><WTH8799> through the wilderness<WH04057>, and compassed<WH05437><WTH8799> the land<WH0776> of Edom<WH0123>, and the land<WH0776> of Moab<WH04124>, and came<WH0935><WTH8799> by the east side<WH04217><WH08121> of the land<WH0776> of Moab<WH04124>, and pitched<WH02583><WTH8799> on the other side<WH05676> of Arnon<WH0769>, but came<WH0935><WTH8804> not within the border<WH01366> of Moab<WH04124>: for Arnon<WH0769> <FI>was<Fi> the border<WH01366> of Moab<WH04124>.

And Israel<WH03478> sent<WH07971><WTH8799> messengers<WH04397> unto Sihon<WH05511> king<WH04428> of the Amorites<WH0567>, the king<WH04428> of Heshbon<WH02809>; and Israel<WH03478> said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto him, Let us pass<WH05674><WTH8799>, we pray thee, through thy land<WH0776> into<WH05704> my place<WH04725>.

But Sihon<WH05511> trusted<WH0539><WTH8689> not Israel<WH03478> to pass<WH05674><WTH8800> through his coast<WH01366>: but Sihon<WH05511> gathered<WH0622><WH00> all his people<WH05971> together<WH0622><WTH8799>, and pitched<WH02583><WTH8799> in Jahaz<WH03096>, and fought<WH03898><WTH8735> against Israel<WH03478>.

And the LORD<WH03068> God<WH0430> of Israel<WH03478> delivered<WH05414><WTH8799> Sihon<WH05511> and all his people<WH05971> into the hand<WH03027> of Israel<WH03478>, and they smote<WH05221><WTH8686> them: so Israel<WH03478> possessed<WH03423><WTH8799> all the land<WH0776> of the Amorites<WH0567>, the inhabitants<WH03427><WTH8802> of that country<WH0776>.
And they possessed<WH03423><WTH8799> all the coasts<WH01366> of the Amorites<WH0567>, from Arnon<WH0769> even unto Jabbok<WH02999>, and from the wilderness<WH04057> even unto Jordan<WH03383>.

So now the LORD<WH03068> God<WH0430> of Israel<WH03478> hath dispossessed<WH03423><WTH8689> the Amorites<WH0567> from before<WH06440> his people<WH05971> Israel<WH03478>, and shouldest thou possess<WH03423><WTH8799> it?

Wilt not thou possess<WH03423><WTH8799> that which Chemosh<WH03645> thy god<WH0430> giveth thee to possess<WH03423><WTH8686>? So whomsoever the LORD<WH03068> our God<WH0430> shall drive out<WH03423><WTH8689> from before<WH06440> us, them will we possess<WH03423><WTH8799>.

And now <FI>art<Fi> thou any thing better<WH02896> than Balak<WH01111> the son<WH01121> of Zippor<WH06834>, king<WH04428> of Moab<WH04124>? did he ever<WH07378><WTH8800> strive<WH07378><WTH8804> against Israel<WH03478>, or did he ever<WH03898><WTH8736> fight<WH03898><WTH8738> against them,

While Israel<WH03478> dwelt<WH03427><WTH8800> in Heshbon<WH02809> and her towns<WH01323>, and in Aroer<WH06177> and her towns<WH01323>, and in all the cities<WH05892> that <FI>be<Fi> along by the coasts<WH03027> of Arnon<WH0769>, three<WH07969> hundred<WH03967> years<WH08141>? why therefore did ye not recover<WH05337><WTH8689> <FI>them<Fi> within that time<WH06256>?

Wherefore I have not sinned<WH02398><WTH8804> against thee, but thou doest<WH06213><WTH8802><WH0853> me wrong<WH07451> to war<WH03898><WTH8736> against me: the LORD<WH03068> the Judge<WH08199><WTH8802> be judge<WH08199><WTH8799> this day<WH03117> between the children<WH01121> of Israel<WH03478> and the children<WH01121> of Ammon<WH05983>.
Howbeit the king<WH04428> of the children<WH01121> of Ammon<WH05983> hearkened<WH08085><WTH8804> not unto the words<WH01697> of Jephthah<WH03316> which he sent<WH07971><WTH8804> him.<CM>

Then the Spirit<WH07307> of the LORD<WH03068> came upon Jephthah<WH03316>, and he passed over<WH05674><WTH8799> Gilead<WH01568>, and Manasseh<WH04519>, and passed over<WH05674><WTH8799> Mizpeh<WH04708> of Gilead<WH01568>, and from Mizpeh<WH04708> of Gilead<WH01568> he passed over<WH05674><WTH8804> <FI>unto<Fi> the children<WH01121> of Ammon<WH05983>.

And Jephthah<WH03316> vowed<WH05087><WTH8799> a vow<WH05088> unto the LORD<WH03068>, and said<WH0559><WTH8799>, If thou shalt without fail<WH05414><WTH8800> deliver<WH05414><WTH8799> the children<WH01121> of Ammon<WH05983> into mine hands<WH03027>,

Then it shall be, that whatsoever<WH03318><WTH8802> cometh forth<WH03318><WTH8799> of the doors<WH01817> of my house<WH01004> to meet<WH07125><WTH8800> me, when I return<WH07725><WTH8800> in peace<WH07965> from the children<WH01121> of Ammon<WH05983>, shall surely be the LORD'S<WH03068>, and I will offer it up<WH05927><WTH8689> for a burnt offering<WH05930>. <RF>whatsoever...: Heb. that which cometh forth, which shall come forth<Rf> <RF>and...: or, or I will offer it, etc<Rf>

So Jephthah<WH03316> passed over<WH05674><WTH8799> unto the children<WH01121> of Ammon<WH05983> to fight<WH03898><WTH8736> against them; and the LORD<WH03068> delivered<WH05414><WTH8799> them into his hands<WH03027>.

And he smote<WH05221><WTH8686> them from Aroer<WH06177>, even till thou come<WH0935><WTH8800> to Minnith<WH04511>, <FI>even<Fi> twenty<WH06242> cities<WH05892>, and unto the plain<WH058> of the vineyards<WH03754><WTH8677><WH064>, with a very<WH03966> great<WH01419> slaughter<WH04347>. Thus the children<WH01121> of Ammon<WH05983> were subdued<WH03665><WTH8735> before<WH06440> the children<WH01121> of Israel<WH03478>. <RF>the plain: or, Abel<Rf>

And Jephthah<WH03316> came<WH0935><WTH8799> to Mizpeh<WH04709> unto his house<WH01004>, and, behold, his daughter<WH01323> came out<WH03318><WTH8802> to meet<WH07125><WTH8800> him with timbrels<WH08596> and with dances<WH04246>: and she <FI>was his<Fi>  only child<WH03173>; beside her he had neither son<WH01121> nor<WH0176> daughter<WH01323>. <RF>beside...: or, he had not of his own either son or daughter: Heb. of himself<Rf>

And it came to pass, when he saw<WH07200><WTH8800> her, that he rent<WH07167><WTH8799> his clothes<WH0899>, and said<WH0559><WTH8799>, Alas<WH0162>, my daughter<WH01323>! thou hast brought<WH03766><WH00> me very<WH03766><WTH8689> low<WH03766><WTH8687>, and thou art one of them that trouble<WH05916><WTH8802> me: for I have opened<WH06475><WTH8804> my mouth<WH06310> unto the LORD<WH03068>, and I cannot<WH03201><WTH8799> go back<WH07725><WTH8800>.

And she said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto him, My father<WH01>, <FI>if<Fi> thou hast opened<WH06475><WTH8804> thy mouth<WH06310> unto the LORD<WH03068>, do<WH06213><WTH8798> to me according to that which<WH0834> hath proceeded<WH03318><WTH8804> out of thy mouth<WH06310>; forasmuch<WH0310> as the LORD<WH03068> hath taken<WH06213><WTH8804> vengeance<WH05360> for thee of thine enemies<WH0341><WTH8802>, <FI>even<Fi> of the children<WH01121> of Ammon<WH05983>.

And she said<WH0559><WTH8799> unto her father<WH01>, Let this thing<WH01697> be done<WH06213><WTH8735> for me: let me alone<WH07503><WTH8685> two<WH08147> months<WH02320>, that I may go up<WH03212><WTH8799> and down<WH03381><WTH8804> upon the mountains<WH02022>, and bewail<WH01058><WTH8799> my virginity<WH01331>, I and my fellows<WH07464><WTH8675><WH07474>. <RF>go up...: Heb. go and go down<Rf>

And he said<WH0559><WTH8799>, Go<WH03212><WTH8798>. And he sent her away<WH07971><WTH8799> <FI>for<Fi> two<WH08147> months<WH02320>: and she went<WH03212><WTH8799> with her companions<WH07464>, and bewailed<WH01058><WTH8799> her virginity<WH01331> upon the mountains<WH02022>.

And it came to pass at the end<WH07093> of two<WH08147> months<WH02320>, that she returned<WH07725><WTH8799> unto her father<WH01>, who did<WH06213><WTH8799> with her <FI>according<Fi> to his vow<WH05088> which he had vowed<WH05087><WTH8804>: and she knew<WH03045><WTH8804> no man<WH0376>. And it was a custom<WH02706> in Israel<WH03478>, <RF>custom: or, ordinance<Rf>

<FI> That<Fi> the daughters<WH01323> of Israel<WH03478> went<WH03212><WTH8799> yearly<WH03117><WH03117> to lament<WH08567><WTH8763> the daughter<WH01323> of Jephthah<WH03316> the Gileadite<WH01569> four<WH0702> days<WH03117> in a year<WH08141>. <RF>yearly: Heb. from year to year<Rf> <RF>to lament: or, to talk with<Rf><CM>
